About GradeTargetCalc

Practical tools that make academic planning easier.

Our purpose

GradeTargetCalc is an independent educational calculator project. It helps students estimate grades, understand common formulas and compare academic targets without creating an account.

How we build the tools

We make the assumptions visible, explain the mathematics and include worked examples. Calculations run locally in your browser. We do not request transcripts or claim access to a school’s records.

Scope and independence

We are not a university, examination board or academic advising service. We are not affiliated with the institutions cited in our guides. Estimates cannot replace an institution’s official results or regulations.

Corrections

We aim to correct errors and clarify unclear assumptions. See our methodology and contact page for reporting information.
